post.description:
Seed an isolated demo workspace, or recover the same one after a lost response.

The key needs at least 128 random bits and the proof a separate 256. Send the same pair to recover within
the replay window; use a new pair for a new session.

Args:
    request (CreateDemoSessionRequest): The scenario.
    service (DemoService): Demo rules.
    response (Response): Lets a replay answer 200.
    idempotency_key (str): Operation ID.
    replay_proof (str): Secret replay proof.

Returns:
    DemoSessionResponse: Token and workspace.

Returns:
    DemoWorkspaceResponse: The workspace.

post.description:
Mark useful or not relevant, snooze until the next local midnight, hide or restore one revision.

Feedback changes no measurement, asset, source or device. Retry an unknown outcome with the same key; a new
action needs a new key.

    request (FeedbackRequest): Action and revision.

    service (FeedbackService): Feedback rules.

Returns:

Store a preview of a file or pasted text. A blocked preview is a 201 with ``blocked`` true.

This takes ``Request`` rather than declared form fields, because FastAPI parses those before any dependency. So
the site is resolved first, and a foreign site answers ``NOT_FOUND`` with nothing read.

Args:
    site_id (UUID): The site.
    request (Request): The request, whose body is read only after ownership is known.
    principal (PrincipalModel): The acting principal.
    service (ImportPreviewService): Preview rules.

Returns:
    ImportPreviewResponse: The stored preview.
